form.name: Request name

form.expirationRequired: Choose a closing date or turn this condition off

sections.limitsHelp: Storage limits block extra uploads. Close conditions turn the link off.

form.folderHelp: Received files go here. The folder contents stay private.
form.storageLimitHelp: Reject uploads over this total. The request stays open.
form.stopAfterSizeHelp: Close when received files reach this total.
form.allowedTypesHelp: Add extensions or MIME types. Leave empty to accept anything.
form.expiresAtHelp: Leave blank to keep this request open until you close it.
form.passwordHelp: Optional. Uploaders must enter this before sending files.
form.passwordEditHelp: Leave blank to keep the current password.
form.enabledHelp: Turn off to stop uploads without deleting the request.
